mutants.find: lines = log.splitlines()[1:]  # the first line is the SHA
mutants.replace: lines = log.splitlines()  # the first line is the SHA
mutants.why: The first line of a real log is `%H`, 40 hex digits, which can match neither a trailer, a Generated-with line nor the emoji. Holds for any input the snapshot can contain; it would not hold if the first line could be free text.
